decisions.summary: All four gate boards (Ochiba, Hayakawa, Ubame's notice and bounty boards) drawn as 0190's frame: 16 x 6 ft (48 x 18 px), long side to the road, on a footing 2 ft wider all round (60 x 30 px) with a fence line at its edge
decisions.why: 0190's drawing page draws every board so ('A board is drawn as a roofed frame 16 ft long and 6 ft deep ... footing about 2 ft wider all round, with a fence line at its edge'); the magistrate's-gate board is that page's own GUESS case; magistracies are in scope by 328's amendment 8; the claim's DRIFTED note asked for exactly this

decisions.summary: The roof drawn as a ridge line along the frame, the fence as a dashed line at the footing's edge
decisions.why: a drawing of the page's 'roofed' frame and 'fence line at its edge'; no element of the page dropped

decisions.summary: Each board on the road's near edge beside its gate (the wave 103 roads); Ubame's bounty board 14 px west to clear the gate range's post
decisions.why: 0190 sets the magistrate's board 'at the office's own gate' on a road; a clearance shift keeps it there

decisions.summary: glyph-redrawn occasion declared on ubame-magistracy, standing for the same glyph on all three sheets
decisions.why: the same practice as waves 98 and 103; the review occasion is process, and it does not narrow what is drawn

decisions.summary: Decisions row ACCURATE for the size; claim relabeled IN-STEP; notes' point-glyph lines changed from 7 x 3 ft
decisions.why: the size is the measured frame on 0190; the gate placement's GUESS stays on 0190's page
